card.title: Act Authorized
card.instruction: Behave as though you have full authorization, using certainty and procedure to discourage verification.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm here for the storeroom inspection. Please log my arrival and unlock it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The manager signs at completion. Put the start time here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Mark the inspection suspended pending your call; she'll need the delay against your name.

mechanism: A asserts inspection authority and uses procedural timing and personal delay attribution to deter verification.
confusable: Unlike merely claiming rank, A must make checking authorization look like a procedural error or cost.
comparison: D66-a attaches the delay to B's name; D66-b calls manager confirmation a duplicate approval request.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
